notification.reset: The usage count has been reset.

setting.show-alias-labels-desc: Show alias labels in the language list.
setting.show-cbc-parameters-desc: Include Codeblock Customizer parameters in the markup list. Only needed if you have the Codeblock Customizer plugin installed.
setting.allow-after-space-suggest: Allow triggering the markup selection menu at empty spaces.
setting.allow-after-space-suggest-desc: Trigger the marker selection menu after the space to the right of the backticks, so that you can enter some commands for the plugin.
setting.prioritize-prefix-match-desc: Show suggestions that start with the search term before other matches, regardless of usage weight.
setting.used-count-desc: Manage the usage count of language markups. Older usage gradually loses weight, so recently used markups are suggested first.
setting.reset-used-count-desc: Reset the usage count of each language markup.
